thread:
anna: Heads up — planning to start staged rollout from fp16 -> int8 -> int4 for sherpa-v2-prod tomorrow. Want a quick sync on guardrails and audience sizing before flipping anything. TL;DR: small canary, automated rollback, health checks, eval hooks.

sam: +1. Can we use the feature flag `feature.quant_profile` with values `fp16,int8,int4`? propose rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6h windows. 1% runway has to pass perf + quality checks to continue.

taro: SRE checklist: must have kill switch route (`/flags/feature.quant_profile=fp16`) AND an automatic fallback if p95 latency > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 5m windows. Who owns the alert thresholds? :eyes:

anna: I'll own alerts for quality and latency during ramp. Sam, can you add a canary tag so we can isolate logs? e.g., `x-canary-group: sherpa-quant-canary` in headers.

sam: Will do. Also adding an audience attribute so we limit to non-critical tenants: `audience=canary-small`. Rollout config snippet: 
```
# redwoodctl rollout plan
flag: feature.quant_profile
steps:
  - percent: 1
    profile: int8
    duration: 6m
  - percent: 5
    profile: int8
    duration: 30m
  - percent: 25
    profile: int4
    duration: 3h
  - percent: 100
    profile: int4
    duration: 2h
```
Note: first two steps keep int8 only for quality baseline, then int4 for larger audience.

lina: For quality, add prompt-set evals and a small augment of our hallucination probes. We should compare exact-match and semantic-similarity against golden set. If semantic-similarity drops > 2% vs fp16 baseline, fail. Also add token-distribution smoke tests to detect truncation.

taro: Ops-bot will watch infra metrics. Can we get a synthetic probe hitting the canary every minute? If synthetic fails 5 times in a row, auto-revert.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled synthetic heartbeat for `sherpa-quant-canary` created — probe interval 60s. Alert policy: fire when 5 consecutive failures.

anna: Quick check: how to flip the flag manually in emergencies? use `redwoodctl` or the admin UI. Example CLI: 
```
redwoodctl flags set feature.quant_profile=int4 --audience=canary-small --reason="canary_test"
# rollback
redwoodctl flags set feature.quant_profile=fp16 --audience=canary-small --reason="auto_revert"
```
Make sure runbooks link in the alert so oncall can execute.

sam: I'll add the runbook link to the alert and enable a subtle ramp-only rate limit so bursts don't saturate the canary GPU pool. Also documenting which model shard variants map to each profile.

lina: One more: include a small eval hook that posts batch eval results to #eng-ml/quant-evals channel and to the rollout dashboard. If regression, block next ramp step.

taro: Confirmed — canary group created, synthetic probe in place, alert with runbook linked. Ops team will monitor latency and GPU utilization.

anna: Thanks all. If nothing blocks, I'll start the 1% int8 canary at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Ping me in thread when ready; I'll do the flip and watch the first 30m.

sam: I'll post a short checklist in the console and tag @taro when probes are green.

lina: I'll prepare a 50-prompt smoke eval and share results in this thread after the first step.

anna: perfect. mark as async check-in — flagging for follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
